FX-RIPPLE-001.says: The settings as they start: centre 50, 50, the point (8, 5), amplitude 5, wavelength 30, speed 20, phase 0, fade 0. Each pixel reads from up to five pixels along its line through the centre. On frame 0 every pixel reads from further out, so the drawing is drawn in toward the centre, a small patch with empty all round it. The rings move outward: the still ring, where nothing moves, is at the centre on frame 0, 3.33 pixels out on frame 2 and 6.67 on frame 4, and inside it each pixel reads from nearer the centre, so the middle of the band is magnified while the rest is still drawn in; the three frames differ.

FX-RIPPLE-002.says: Amplitude 0: the drawing, untouched, on every frame.

FX-RIPPLE-003.says: Amplitude 1, wavelength 4, speed 0: a ring every four pixels, each pixel reading from at most one pixel away, so the stripes wobble in rings about the centre; with speed 0 the rings hold still, the same on frames 0, 2 and 4.

FX-RIPPLE-004.says: FX-RIPPLE-003 with speed 90: frame 0 is FX-RIPPLE-003; frame 2, half a turn on, is phase 180, FX-RIPPLE-005; and frame 4, a full turn on, is FX-RIPPLE-003 again, to within rounding.

FX-RIPPLE-005.says: FX-RIPPLE-003 with phase 180: half a turn, so every pixel reads from the same distance the other way, out where FX-RIPPLE-003 reads in.

FX-RIPPLE-006.says: FX-RIPPLE-003 with wavelength 8: the rings twice as far apart, a gentler wobble.

FX-RIPPLE-007.says: FX-RIPPLE-003 with speed -90: the rings move inward. Frame 1, a quarter turn back, differs from speed 90's frame 1, a quarter turn on; frame 2, half a turn back, is FX-RIPPLE-004's frame 2, half a turn on, to within rounding.

FX-RIPPLE-008.says: Speed 0, fade 6: the reach dies away with the distance from the centre, to nothing at six pixels, so every pixel six or more from (8, 5) is the drawing's own, and every nearer pixel reads from less far than it would with fade 0.

FX-RIPPLE-009.says: FX-RIPPLE-003 with the centre at 53.125, 55, the middle of pixel (8, 5): that pixel, at no distance from the centre, is its own; the rest ripple about it.

FX-RIPPLE-010.says: The centre at 53.125, 55 and fade 0.5, the rest as they start: pixel (8, 5) is at the centre and every other pixel at least a pixel away, past the fade, so nothing moves and the drawing is untouched on every frame.

FX-RIPPLE-011.says: FX-RIPPLE-003 with the centre 0, 0, the top left corner: the rings are quarter circles about the corner.

FX-RIPPLE-012.says: FX-RIPPLE-003 with the centre keyed from 50, 50 at frame 0 to 0, 0 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-RIPPLE-003, frame 2 rings about 25, 25, the point (4, 2.5), and frame 4 is FX-RIPPLE-011.

FX-RIPPLE-013.says: Wavelength 4, speed 0, amplitude keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is amplitude 1, FX-RIPPLE-003, and frame 4 amplitude 2.

FX-RIPPLE-014.says: Fade keyed from 20 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4, eased past its end (-6.5 at frame 2), the rest as they start: frame 0 is fade 20; frame 2 is held at 0, no fade, and is FX-RIPPLE-001's frame 2; frame 4 is FX-RIPPLE-001's frame 4.

FX-RIPPLE-015.says: FX-RIPPLE-001 moved three pixels right: the rings are worked in the drawing's own space, so they move with it, and the three columns left of the drawing stay empty, as the layer does not grow.

FX-RIPPLE-016.says: Amplitude 1, wavelength 1, speed 0: a ring every pixel, so neighbouring pixels read from unalike places and the stripes break up.

FX-RIPPLE-017.says: Speed 360, the rest as they start: a full turn every frame, so the ripple seems to stand still, every frame FX-RIPPLE-001's frame 0 to within rounding.

FX-RIPPLE-018.says: Speed 0, phase 40: FX-RIPPLE-001's frame 2, which is phase 0 plus two frames of 20 degrees.

FX-RIPPLE-019.says: Amplitude 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RIPPLE-020.says: Amplitude -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RIPPLE-021.says: Wavelength 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RIPPLE-022.says: Speed 361, above 360. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RIPPLE-023.says: Phase -100001, below -100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RIPPLE-024.says: Fade -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RIPPLE-025.says: Centre 50, 1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RIPPLE-026.says: Amplitude keyed to 1500 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
